newsitem.title: USA: DynaGen files to market nicotine test.
newsitem.headline: DynaGen files to market nicotine test.

text.p: DynaGen Inc said on Tuesday it had filed a 510(k) application with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration seeking clearance to market its NicCheck I nicotine test.
NicCheck I is a 15-minute test that assesses nicotine consumption by tobacco users.
The color test measures the urinary content of nicotine and its metabolic breakdown products.
NicCheck I is able to differentiate between low and high consumers of nicotine by the intensity of the color reaction, DynaGen said.
Analysis of clinical trial data shows that as an indication of nicotine consumption, NicCheck I is more reliable than simply counting the number of cigarettes smoked each day, the company said.
Market research conducted on behalf of the company suggests acceptance for the product, particularly among health maintenance organizations, DynaGen said.
